      Problem: `_json_pointer_from_path` produces an ambiguous, non-standard hybrid format.; It produces pointers like `$.key.with.dots` where a key containing a literal dot (e.g., `"app.v1"`) becomes indistinguishable from a nested object path (`{"app": {"v1": ...}}`). RFC 6901 standardizes JSON Pointers to avoid this by using `/` as a separator and escaping `~` and `/`. By using `.` and only escaping `~` and `/`, this implementation fails to provide a unique path to manifest errors.
      Confidence: avg 4.0
      Flagged by: google_gemini-3-flash-preview
